description:
What is This Part?
This is the Distributor Cap Rubber Gasket that fits directly below the Cap.
This seal keeps out water and debris.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Distributor Cap Rubber Gasket
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
